scope: Supplement to immutable a441 source-pins.json; mutation wrappers only invalidate, never model final MP4 extents

generation_source.native: rm-file-device.c::native_rm_file_media_generation forwards native_sd_hotplug_generation; sd-hotplug-runtime.c returns 0 unless enabled and owned by current pid
generation_source.fallback: file-media-config.c uses successful original validated card Mount/owned Unmount events only; FSYS_SYNC_MEDIA domain=observed_mount; no constructor, no epoch from filename, no substitution for native_hotplug
generation_source.unknown: No observed mount, inherited owner, invalidated drive or actual epoch 0 remains unknown and rejects verification

unclosed_boundaries: Fsys_Open flags through backend fopen modes and initial extent/cursor
Source allocation/lease extent; count is not extent evidence
Combine final extent/path mapping, Fsys_CombineV2, RemoveAll and other unwrapped aliases
Runtime FSYS_SYNC checker ingestion and original movie/host commit/independent decode

windows.role: Fsys_Combine: saves x0/x1 only; lower helper w2=0; two original path arguments
Combine lower helper: original x0/x1 each passed to fsys_CreatePathInfo
Fsys_Rename: x0 source path, x1 new name; PrFILE/TNtfs rename
Fsys_Remove: original x0 path only; original x1 overwritten before use
